notes.title: An important first update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone, Yan here with an important first patch![/p][p][/p][p]It's been exactly a week and a day since the game's launch, and I've been super happy to see people starting to pick it up and enjoy it. I'll get to that, but first, I want to address something else - after gathering a lot of feedback from early players, I've gotten a much better idea of our audience's skillset, and identified a lot of the pain points in the game's progression. As such, I've compiled a patch that will make the play experience much better suited for the majority of players interested in the game. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Here's a list of changes![/b]
[/p][list][*][p]The biggest point of frustration so far has been the platforming game, where the level of challenge was way overtuned. It has been toned down to be more forgiving, in conjunction with some of the other more dexterity/reflex-focused parts of the game, such as some segments of the final level.[/p][/*][*][p]The beggining of the music level has been reworked, as some players were getting confused with the unclear rules. The new pamphlet on the ground, as well as the noise meter, should help give the player better feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]The lights in the hotel now have the correct intensity - they were previously WAY too strong when you turned on the camcorder, which was not intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some poignant content to the ending sequence, as well as fixed a bug where the sequence would not fade in properly.[/p][/*][*][p]The concierge will now be less picky about when he accepts the suit (oops). Also, he has something to say about each of your items now! Probably nothing helpful though.[/p][/*][*][p]The game will now save your settings properly (gamma, volume, language etc)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed access to the rooftop mirror without the camcorder, causing unexpected behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause some of the subtitles in one of the car cutscenes to not show.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supposedly[/b] fixed the bug where occasionally a loud static noise would play during the orbs' level - it would only happen rarely and on some PCs, so if it's still happening, please let me know![/p][/*][*][p]Many other such bug fixes and quality of life changes![/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]What's next?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is what we have planned for the next patch, which will be coming shortly:
[/p][list][*][p]Adding the projector room, wherein players can watch past cutscenes more readily.[/p][/*][*][p]Revised text, particularly in Portuguese.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworking some cutscene subtitles to be shorter and more readable.[/p][/*][*][p]Other assorted small improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Then after THAT update, the next one will feature new content, so it'll take a little while more.[/p][p][/p][p]We'll still be tweaking the game so that it lands in the perfect sweetspot between challenge and satisfaction (and hunting for any other pesky bugs that pop up), so please keep sending us feedback! You can do it through the Steam hub, or through our email at [b]kodinoartes@gmail.com[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Oh, and...[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I'd also like to thank these 3 streamers that randomly decided to play the game on release day, which helped us out a lot not only with great feedback but also by greatly lowering our insecurity levels. ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/cast_iron_cat"][/dynamiclink] (EN)[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/valkyrieshepard"][/dynamiclink] (EN)[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/korodashie"][/dynamiclink] (FR)[/p][p]Check them out, good vibes all around![/p][p][/p][p][b]Last thing.[/b][/p][p]No one has solved the $500 riddle yet. The bounty stands, for now...[/p][p][/p][p][b]So![/b][/p][p]Thank you so much for playing! Despite the hiccups, the response has been overall very positive so far, which is a big relief. Thank you especially to those who took the time to leave a positive review - really cannot be understated how much that helps us out.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers, and see you soon![/p][p]Yan[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: CHECK IN NOW! Plus a $500 BOUNTY...
notes.notes:
[h1][b]THE TIME HAS COME.[/b][/h1][h3]The doors have swung open to our strange, desolate hotel, inviting you in for an introspective journey like no other. [/h3][p]
After years of hard work, I'm excited to announce that our game Concierge is finally available. It's a labor of love and me and Lucas put a lot of ourselves into it, so we eagerly hope that it will resonate with you![/p][p][/p][h2][b]ALSO - there's a $500 USD reward. Yep.[/b][/h2][p]As graciously offered by our partner Digital Tribe, this bounty is available to the FIRST person who solves a dastardly riddle hidden deep within the walls of the hotel. Think you've got what it takes to be the most overachieving explorer of all of them? Have at it! [b]You have until the end of Halloween, November 3rd.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]-- What's next? --[/b][/p][p]We're not done with the game. We'll keep patching bugs and improving the experience, and you can expect a free update with an entire additional quest and new cutscenes coming in the near future.[/p][p][/p][p]Please, please, please let us hear your thoughts! Every kind of feedback is welcome. And let us know of any bugs you find, please! We're a tiny studio, so these kind of things can slip by sometimes. You can use the Steam hub or e-mail me directly at [url="https://kodinoartes@gmail.com"]kodinoartes@gmail.com[/url].[/p][p]

Enjoy your stay![/p][p]-Yan[/p]

notes.title: CONCIERGE is coming soon!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello![/h3][p][/p][p]Yan here, dev for Concierge. 

I'm excited and anxious to announce that this weird egg of a project will soon be available to the public, when [b]the game[/b] [b]officially launches on September 17th. [/b]Check out the new trailer on our Steam page!
[/p][p]In an era where it feels like all genres have been discovered and the main mystery is often whether the scary monster is behind this corner or the next, me and my partner Lucas decided to honor the fact that we have no shareholders to answer to and genuinely try to make something artistic and engaging in equal terms.
[/p][p]Concierge is unique, yet strangely familiar.  We set out to create an unpredictable game that respects your sense of curiosity, perseverance and intuition. It's a highly introspective and abstract journey meant to reignite a sense of intrigue in even the most terminally cynical of internet natives. There are many possible routes to take, tons of secrets to find, and no easy answers. [/p][p][/p][p]We know it's not for everyone, but if the above sounds interesting, please give Concierge a shot! We've put a lot of love into this thing, so we're beyond excited to hear any kind of feedback. Hopefully your time with the game will be as satisfying as ours! [/p][p][/p][p]See you on the inside, please wishlist our game and check-in starting [b]September 17th![/b][/p][p][/p][p]-Yan[/p]
